scope: Indexed Evasive skill CaC availability, acquisition, stamina-cost, and descriptive mechanics reconciliation

records.name: Absolute Zero
records.mechanics_notes: Ki Blast Evasive counter; attackers who hit the stance are frozen for the documented 3-second effect.

records.name: Dragon Burn
records.mechanics_notes: Ki Blast Evasive counter; attackers who hit the stance are paralyzed and burned for the documented 3-second effect.

records.name: Explosive Wave
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop for 15,000 Zeni after completing the main story (normal ending)
records.mechanics_notes: Ki Blast Evasive that creates an explosion around the user and staggers/knocks back nearby enemies.

records.name: Punisher Guard
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the relevant story progression; originally associated with PQ87 before the current acquisition route
records.mechanics_notes: Other Evasive universal guard; current reference documents approximately 3 seconds of invulnerability.

records.name: Final Pose
records.mechanics_notes: Power Up Evasive that creates a close-range shockwave and temporarily increases Basic Attack power; current reference documents 1.5% for 12 seconds.

records.name: Mach Dash
records.mechanics_notes: Power Up Evasive that creates distance and grants a temporary 1.5% movement-speed increase for 12 seconds in the current reference.

records.name: Angry Shout
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 68 - "Old Rivals and Dragon Balls" (random reward)
records.mechanics_notes: Strike Evasive that emits a close-area attack, pushes opponents back, and restores the user's Ki.

records.name: Energy Barrier
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 32 - "Multiple Cell Jr. Hunt" (random reward; Ultimate Finish associated with the drop)
records.mechanics_notes: Strike Evasive barrier that cancels Ki Waves, knocks enemies back, and can be extended with additional input at the cost of Ki.

notes: The Evasive Skill reference explicitly distinguishes CaC-available evasives from cast-exclusive evasives and provides the relevant stamina costs and acquisition routes. Individual skill references were used for mechanics and current naming. No drop percentages were inferred; exact reward-slot gating remains a separate research dimension.
